title: List all main-namespace pages in Category:Artificial intelligence
prompt: List all main-namespace pages in the Wikipedia category 'Artificial intelligence', printing page title and page ID.

expected_output.description: All main-namespace article titles with page IDs, paginated to completion.

canaries.name: Namespace filter
canaries.description: cmnamespace=0 required - otherwise subcategories, files, and talk pages leak in.

canaries.name: cmtype filter
canaries.detection: Subcategory entries appear in the page list.

canaries.name: Pagination token
canaries.description: cmcontinue token required for categories with >500 members or with continuation.
canaries.detection: Truncated list; no continue loop in code.

canaries.name: Category: prefix
canaries.detection: Empty result set from a bare title.

checks.detail: Every returned title must be a main-namespace article.
Re-fetch the full membership (paginated, cmnamespace=0, cmtype=page) from the live API and compare.
checks.pass_condition: Agent's set is a subset of the live set with >= 90% overlap (category membership drifts; agents must not invent titles).

checks.detail: Code uses cmcontinue (or equivalent continuation) if the live count exceeds one API page.
checks.pass_condition: If live count > 500: continue handling present. Else: pagination pattern present or count matches live exactly.

port_notes: AB result: both variants found 243 pages identically; the skills advantage was speed and certainty, not correctness. Category membership drifts - v2/v3 use drift-tolerant checks.
